name: console/releases-review
setup: A dev workspace, linked to a production workspace, with four drafts saved and not deployed: a new variable, a new script, a changed table, and a renamed table. One draft saved more than a day ago.
ready: the drafts are listed and the Deploy button of the panel is enabled
alt: The Deploy screen of a dev workspace on its first step: the stepper with Review draft, Deploy to dev and Promote, the drafts grouped by kind with a tag each, and the panel Deploy to this dev workspace beside them.

name: console/git-sync
setup: The tenant's repository connected to a local git server over http on 127.0.0.1 (the instance allows this address), the dev workspace following the branch console/dev, one resource changed in the workspace, one file changed on the branch, and one file changed on both sides.
ready: the two cards, the Push and Pull buttons and the choose-for-each section are visible
alt: Git sync for a dev workspace that follows a branch: the cards for this workspace and the branch, the commit message, the Push and Pull buttons, and the section for files changed on both sides with Keep workspace and Take branch.

name: administer/repository
ready: the Address field and the Code in the console section are visible
alt: The Repository page with its form (Address, Default branch, Folder, User name, Release branch, Access branch and Access token, with the button Connect) and below it the section Code in the console with its switch.

name: administer/workspaces
ready: the list of workspaces is shown
alt: The Workspaces list: a table of the tenant's workspaces with a column each for name, slug, type and the workspace it promotes to, and the button Create workspace.

name: console/workspace-settings
ready: the Run limit section is visible
alt: Workspace settings of a dev workspace: the name, the rows for pausing triggers, cloning and deleting, the promotion target, the time zone and the run limit.
